newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Iran sees no military solution in Afghanistan.
newsitem.headline: Iran sees no military solution in Afghanistan.

text.p: Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati said on Thursday there was no military solution to the conflict in neighbouring Afghanistan.
Velayati said Afghanistan needed "a broad-based government in which all different ethnic and religious groups should participate" if it was to attain lasting peace.
He was speaking at a news briefing at the annual meeting of foreign ministers of the Organisation of the Islamic Conference (OIC) in Jakarta.
The organisers of the OIC meeting were unable to decide who should represent Afghanistan and left Kabul's seat vacant.
"Afghanistan is being destroyed more and more and the political situation is deteriorating. We believe there is no military solution.
"(What is needed is) a broad-based government, a stop in foreign intervention and the start of negotiations for a peaceful settlement," Velayati said.
He said the United Nations, backed by such groups as the 54-member OIC, should take the lead in the reconstruction and development of Afghanistan.
